name: Lakeland Engineering Equipment Company - Kansas City
old_description: Delta Fabricating designs and manufactures a variety of enclosures to protect your sophisticated electrical and electronic controls, instruments, and components from water, dust, dirt, oil and other environmental conditions. Delta Fabricating specializes in custom enclosures and panels to fit the needs of many industrial and commercial applications while providing quick delivery times.
about:
Lakeland Engineering Equipment Company, headquartered in Kansas City, Kansas, traces its roots to 1952 when Bill Fox founded the business in Minneapolis as a family-owned distributor of process motor controls and electrical components. Over seven decades, the company has grown from a Midwestern supplier into an international enterprise with locations across four states.

The company operates as a broad-line distributor for more than 100 electrical component manufacturers, stocking items such as motor controls, solenoid valves, drives, switches, PLCs, HMIs, and explosion-proof components. Beyond distribution, Lakeland provides equipment rentals for power monitoring and quality testing, engineering and consulting services, custom electrical enclosure fabrication through its Delta Fabricating division, and inventory management programs designed to prevent supply-chain disruptions.

Lakeland serves industrial and commercial customers that rely on electrical control systems, process automation, and hazardous-location equipment. Its client base includes organizations needing rapid access to replacement parts, custom enclosure solutions, and on-site technical support for critical infrastructure.

The company's stated differentiator is a refusal to force customers to choose among quality components, expert service, and fast delivery—a commitment articulated since its founding and reinforced through decades of expansion.
